releases.notes:
## Changes

* Added Attachment value
    * Added `message`~'attachments`
* Added Slash command interaction option value
    * Added `server~'slash_commands'`
    * Added `dc_get_global_slash_commands()` function
* Added slash command value
* Discord events now run on the main game thread instead of javacord's listener thread. This should fix all issues of not being able to access things inside the game in these events.
* All parsables are now parsed using a new parser api. Some behaviours might be different than before
    * Renamed select menu option' `'default'` field to `'default_option'`
* Added `dc_delete(value)` function for deleting discord values
    * Removed `dc_delete_message`, `dc_delete_webhook` and `dc_delete_slash_command` in favor of new `dc_delete`
* Added Slash command builder parsable
    * `dc_create_slash_command(command,server)` now expects a slash command builder and a server (or null for global) as its arguments
* Added [Scarpet Graphics](https://github.com/replaceitem/scarpet-graphics) as a soft dependency for using images
    * Attachment parsable now supports `'image'` as an image value
    * Embed image and thumbnail can now be an image
    * Webhook profile builder and updater avatar can now ba an image
    * Embed author and Embed footer icon can now be an image
* *There might very well be something I missed...*

## Changes

* Added config option `disable_disconnect_logs` to stop repeating messages like these occuring in the logs:
```
[ReadingThread/INFO]: Websocket closed with reason 'Discord commanded a reconnect (Received opcode 7)' and code COMMANDED_RECONNECT (4999) by client!
[ReadingThread/INFO]: Trying to reconnect/resume in 1 seconds!
```
Fixes #22

## Changes

* Added a Role vale
* Added `dc_role_from_id` function
* Added support for assigning and removing roles with `dc_add_role` and `dc_remove_role`
* Added `dc_get_user_role` to query the role of a user in a server
* Added `dc_get_user_color` to get the color of the topmost role of a user in a server
* Deprecated embed builder value in favor of parsing it from maps/lists/...
* Lots of refactoring

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/replaceitem/carpet-discarpet/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0

releases.notes:
# Changes

### 1.4.25

* Extra handling when bots are disconnected, which hopefully solves events triggering multiple times
* Added ability to use privileged Intents, see [Intents](https://github.com/replaceitem/carpet-discarpet/blob/master/docs/Setup.md#intents)
* Added ability to query user list as well as channel list from a server value (`server~'users'`, `server~'channels'`)
* Added example script to docs from @LFGaming

### 1.4.24

* Chages to the discord events, have been causing problems (See #11), please report if you experience some with this version
* `/discarpet` now returns discarpet version and a link to the documentation

### 1.4.21

* Added third parameter to `__on_discord_reaction` to distinguish between adding and removing a reaction, fixes #10 
* Added ability for `dc_emoji_from_id` to return emojis by name
* Made mod be listed under fabric-carpet in ModMenu thanks to @DragonEggBedrockBreaking
* Fixed discord events only working after loading scripts a second time

### 1.4.20

Added everything i guess... See docs
